https://www.mirror.co.uk/3am/celebrity-n.subtitle: The OnlyFans model and the chart topping star went public with their romance with a snog-fuelled date earlier in the week – and friends close to the pair say they are besotted with each other
https://www.mirror.co.uk/3am/celebrity-n.text:
Lottie Moss and musician Tristan Evans have gone public with their romance after secretly dating for the past few weeks.
The 23-year-old model and the 26-year-old drummer of chart topping band The Vamps were spotted snogging on the streets on Notting Hill on Wednesday night after a cosy date.
And now details have emerged of the blossoming romance between OnlyFans sensation Lottie and drum beating hunk Tristan to suggest the pair have been enjoying a passionate relationship for a while.
Lottie and Tristan were seen locking lips outside popular Italian restaurant Gold in West London, with blonde bombshell Lottie affectionately stroking the musician as they kissed.
And the pair chatted enthusiastically as they shared a cigarette following their meal at the flashy, celeb-favoured restaurant.
A source has told The Sun that this may well be the beginning of a very successful romance, with the pair feeling 'serious' about each other.
The source said: “Lottie and Tristan definitely have a spark and there seems to be real chemistry between them.
“They met through friends and have really hit it off. She is seriously keen and told friends she is really into Tristan. It all became public after they had a snog during a night out in the capital but this isn’t just a flash in the pan.
“They’ve been dating for a while and Lottie thinks this could become more serious. Lottie and Tristan have been spending time together out of the public eye and they both seem to be really happy.”
Lottie has previously dated Made In Chelsea stars Alex Mytton and Sam Prince, and also reportedly had a brief fling with radio host Roman Kemp last year.
While Tristan had a four year romance with model Anastasia Smith – which ended shortly after they announced their engagement in 2018.
Both Tristan and Anastasia went on to delete all trace of the other from their respective Instagram feeds – while Anastasia has since gone on to get engaged to Premier League footballer Danny Ings.
With his new romance with Lottie, some fans might wonder if Tristan may feature in the erotic photography that she shares online.
Speaking about her love of creating titillating photos to share online – and which members of the public can view, for a fee – Lottie said in an interview last month: “Everyone thinks modelling is really glamorous, but you get there and it’s these guys who are like 30 taking pictures of girls who are like 16 to 17 years old in their underwear. It’s creepy, it’s weird.
“Everyone thinks OnlyFans is the sex industry and that it’s creepy and weird and genuinely it’s so not, because it’s all girls, all my friends, taking my pictures and I’m taking their pictures.
“We’re so comfortable with each other, and you get better pictures because it’s us playing around.”
Reflecting on a shoot she enjoyed in a mansion, she added: “It’s amazing. It’s so glamorous walking around in a million-pound mansion in my heels. Liberated, yeah. I’m a very sexual person, so I love that.
“I love that I can just be sexual and free, and post what I wanna post. I take these pictures and my friends take these pictures for me, and that’s what I like more than modelling as well — the fact I get final approval over everything.”
